gpu_tip: ~36GB total at 128K context. Lower quality than the Q4 rung but usable, with embedding and output weights kept at Q8_0. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5060) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it via llama.cpp's layer offloading. The ~18GB KV cache doesn't shrink with the weights, so the KV cache knob's q4_0 option saves more than dropping another rung.
mac_tip: Needs ~36GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably; a 36GB M4 Max or M5 Max is tight.
